title: Approval of the Award of a one (1)-year Contract to S&L Specialty Construction Inc.: With a 180-day extension option, covering construction services for Bid Group 11 of the Los Angeles International A
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 9]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a one (1)-year Contract to S&L Specialty Construction Inc.: With a 180-day extension option, covering construction services for Bid Group 11 of the Los Angeles International Airport Residential Sound Insulation Program, for cost not to exceed $2,468,100; a budgeted change order of $250,000; and appropriation of $2,718,100 in capital funds for project implementation (Dillon Pettyjohn)
summary: Awards a one-year, up to $2,468,100 construction contract to S&L Specialty Construction for Bid Group 11 of LAX's residential sound insulation program, and appropriates $2,718,100 in capital funds for the work.
